The '''Bomis Koori system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Wornal sector/Legends|Wornal sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar]] colony world [[Bomis Koori IV]].
